Tamil Nadu Power Purchase Sparks Political Storm

A political storm has erupted in Tamil Nadu over the purchase of electricity at a rate of Rs 35-37 per unit. Edappadi K. Palaniswami, leader of the opposition, has termed the purchase a "vettri mega scam". The issue has led to significant political controversy within the state.
